name: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd
title: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd - 539876 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue up 11% to Rs 2,283 Cr with EBIT margin exiting near 10% from 6.8% in H1, but management flagged April material cost inflation with no numeric guidance and no supply-side or capex disclosure.

triggers.label: 7-8% price hikes in lead category
triggers.quote: we've taken about 7% to 8% price increase in our lead category like fans

triggers.label: Q4 EBIT margin ~10% vs 6.8% H1
triggers.quote: Our EBIT margins improved from 6.8% in H1 to exit at about 10% in Q4

triggers.label: Further material cost inflation in April
triggers.quote: we are seeing further material cost inflation happening in April

triggers.label: Competitors not yet following price hikes
triggers.quote: I am hoping that competition , rather than playing the pricing game , will now also start to see

triggers.label: Solar rooftop order book ~Rs 500 Cr
triggers.quote: the order book to order of magnitude about Rs. 500 Cr

guidance.quote: we want to build a Rs. 1,500 Cr business in the next 3- 4 years

red_flags.label: Impairment of Butterfly holding
red_flags.quote: we've taken an impairment on our Butterfly holding value

red_flags.label: Management declining to give segment breakdown
red_flags.quote: I'm sorry, we don't really break that down. That's not something that we've been doing historically.

evasions.quote: I would not speculate so much, and if you don't mind, we'll not talk about what kind of revenues will come in each one of these businesses.

evasions.topic: FY26 ECD category growth vs 1% figure
evasions.quote: the growth is not 1%. So, while you have an offline conversation
